import urllib.request
request=urllib.request.Request('http://localhost:3123/product', headers={'RSC':'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'1','Next-Url':'/'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
    body=response.read().decode()
print('Prefetch status:', response.status)
print('Content type:', response.headers.get('Content-Type'))
print('Title present:', 'Premium Widget' in body)
print('Loading fallback present:', 'Loading inventory...' in body)
print('Live inventory present:', 'in stock' in body)
print('Response length:', len(body))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
workspace = Path('/workspace')
build_dir = workspace / '.next'
generated_types = workspace / 'next-env.d.ts'
if build_dir.is_dir() and build_dir.resolve() == workspace / '.next':
    shutil.rmtree(build_dir)
if generated_types.is_file() and generated_types.resolve() == workspace / 'next-env.d.ts':
    generated_types.unlink()
